LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdLaunchDesc: Takes the whole ship into orbit above this planet. Costs {0} chemfuel. Launch quality depends on the pilot, copilot and thrust.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdLandDesc: Lands the ship on the planet below. Costs {0} chemfuel.
LanguageData.Rimverse_NoOrbitTile: There is no free space in orbit above.
LanguageData.Rimverse_NoLandingTile: There is nowhere to land below.
LanguageData.Rimverse_NoLandingSpot: There is no clear area big enough for the ship on the map below.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemMultipleBridges: There is more than one bridge on the same hull.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemOverLimit: The hull is over the bridge's limit of {0} cells.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemBridgeOffline: The bridge has no power or is switched off.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemAir: Not enough air for the crew: capacity {0} APH of {1} needed.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterLaunch_Bad: {0} reached orbit, but the launch was rough (quality {1}).
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterLanding_Bad: {0} landed, but the landing was rough (quality {1}).
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgHeatShutdown: {0} shut down because of heat on {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgHeatFire: Heat is at maximum on {0}: a fire broke out.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgRandomBreach: The hull of {0} is weak and has breached.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AlertAirLowDesc:
Air stock is below 30% on: {0}.
Build air generators and tanks, seal rooms or carry fewer people. Below 20% air in a room, hypoxia starts.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AlertHeatHighDesc:
Heat is above 70% on: {0}.
Above 80% modules shut down one by one. At 100% fires start. Build radiators and heat banks.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AlertIntegrityLowDesc:
Hull integrity is below 60% on: {0}.
Below 50% random breaches appear. Repair and rebuild hull walls.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AlertOverLimitDesc:
These ships are over their bridge's cell limit or have more than one bridge: {0}.
Build structure modules or a bigger bridge, or split the hulls.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_Role_Desc: What this part does when it is part of a ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_Mass_Desc: Mass added to the ship. More mass needs more thrust and fuel.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_Thrust_Desc: Force for launching and maneuvering. To leave a planet thrust must be at least mass × gravity.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_Heat_Desc: Heat added to the ship meter every second while working.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_HeatRemoval_Desc: Heat taken from the ship meter every second.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_HeatCapacity_Desc: How much heat the ship holds before modules shut down.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_AirPerHour_Desc: Air-pawn-hours (APH) made per hour. An awake person breathes 1 APH per hour.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_AirCapacity_Desc: APH stored. Every sealed room cell also holds 1 APH.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_FuelCapacity_Desc: Chemfuel stored for launching, landing and maneuvering.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_HullPoints_Desc: How much this part adds to hull integrity.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_MaxCells_Desc: How many hull cells this bridge controls.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_ExtraCells_Desc: Adds to the bridge's cell limit.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_Cargo_Desc: Tons of cargo the ship can carry.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_Dodge_Desc: Dodge bonus in ship combat (up to 4 maneuvering thrusters count).
LanguageData.Rimverse_MustBeOnHull: Must be built on hull floor.
